scope: Primary scientific papers/methods, official documentation and separately identified participant evidence. Access depth is explicit; no claims about undisclosed leading teams.

sources.title: Systema: a framework for evaluating genetic perturbation response prediction beyond systematic variation
sources.reviewed_material: Primary full-text results and evaluation-method excerpts
sources.project_implication: Shared stress and selection effects can inflate control-referenced similarities. Add generic-perturbation and shuffled-target controls; retain official scoring and add separate target-specific diagnostics.

sources.title: Deep-learning-based gene perturbation effect prediction does not yet outperform simple linear baselines
sources.project_implication: Compare new networks with strong linear and mean-effect baselines under the same intervention split. This does not establish that every neural architecture fails at this competition.

sources.title: Benchmarking algorithms for generalizable single-cell perturbation response prediction
sources.reviewed_material: Primary abstract and data-availability sections; publisher full-page access failed
sources.project_implication: Generalization depends on context and task. Source family and technical platform must be held out explicitly; additional drug or cytokine data are not automatically CRISPRi training labels.

sources.title: Learning single-cell perturbation responses using neural optimal transport
sources.reviewed_material: Primary abstract and optimal-transport method sections; author repository
sources.project_implication: Unpaired population transport is relevant, but our integer moment fitter is not CellOT. Test distributions and covariance as well as population means; any neural OT model needs intervention training and held-context checks.

sources.title: Deep generative modeling for single-cell transcriptomics
sources.reviewed_material: Primary count-likelihood and dispersion method sections
sources.project_implication: Gene-specific count dispersion and latent cell states are separable. A gamma-Poisson pilot tests dispersion only; it is not a trained scVI model and does not preserve biological covariance.

sources.title: Characterizing the molecular regulation of inhibitory immune checkpoints with multi-modal single-cell screens
sources.reviewed_material: Primary heterogeneous-response results and Mixscape description
sources.project_implication: Guide-bearing cells can include transcriptomic responders and nonresponders. Source efficacy scaling may mix response magnitude with responder fraction. Keep all genuine validation cells; do not assume knockout observations apply quantitatively to CRISPRi.

sources.title: False discovery rates: a new deal
sources.reviewed_material: Primary empirical-Bayes and local false-sign-rate method sections
sources.project_implication: Estimate directional uncertainty rather than interpreting sign agreement as calibrated confidence. Local false-sign rates require a fitted posterior and validated likelihood; our z proxy is not one.

sources.title: Flexible statistical methods for estimating and testing effects in genomic studies with multiple conditions
sources.reviewed_material: Primary abstract/method summary and author software documentation
sources.project_implication: Learn heterogeneous sharing patterns instead of only scalar pooling. Mash does not automatically predict an entirely unmeasured context: that needs an explicit training-only mapping and whole-family validation.

sources.title: Mapping transcriptional responses to cellular perturbation dictionaries with RNA fingerprinting
sources.reviewed_material: Primary factor-model/mapping sections and pinned author R/fit.R; author README links preprint 10.1101/2025.09.19.676866
sources.project_implication: Control-derived factors and a rank-one perturbation factor separate baseline state from response strength. Fingerprints live in a normalized residual space and are not directly count fold changes. Query mapping requires observed query responses; challenge controls alone cannot provide those.

sources.title: Genome-wide single-cell perturbation screens with VIPerturb-seq
sources.reviewed_material: Primary preprint methods/data availability and original Zenodo manifest
sources.project_implication: Probe-based K562 genetic data may reduce platform mismatch and expand evidence. The manifest gives all 300 targets but few cells per target; QC-filtered membership and actual knockdown need checking. Treat this as K562, not an independent lineage.

sources.title: Behind the data: Virtual Cell Challenge 2026
sources.project_implication: Probe-based challenge profiling and strong knockdown motivate platform-aware source checks. They do not identify anonymous contexts or establish transferability from controls.

sources.title: Sidechain public model log, SER-15 and SER-14
sources.reviewed_material: Participant report checked 2026-10-09; not independently reproduced
sources.project_implication: A real-control emission experiment improved local tests but sharply reduced the reported leaderboard score. Preserve distribution realism as a diagnostic and require perturbation-level confirmation before replacement.
